name: api v1.1.0
body:
# kpt API v1.1.0

Minor release. Additive and backward-compatible — no breaking changes to the Go API; import paths are unchanged.

## Features

- **KubeObject moved into the `api` module** (#4767) — the `kubeobject` package (with `node/` and `kptfile/` subpackages) is now part of `github.com/kptdev/kpt/api`.
- **Server-side apply configurations** (#4701) — generated apply-configuration types for the `kptfile` and `fnresult` APIs under `generated/applyconfigurations`.
- **`Selector.ResourceFileRegexp`** (#4743) — select resources by matching their file path (relative to package root) against a regular expression.
- **`Upstream.PreserveExplicitNull`** (#4745) — keep explicitly-nulled fields during `resource-merge` instead of deleting them (resource-merge strategy only).
- **`ResultItem` now implements `error`** — added an `Error()` method.

## Behavioral changes

- **Stricter Kptfile validation** (#4742, #4750) — comprehensive field validation now rejects some Kptfiles that previously passed. `upstream.git.repo` now also accepts scp-style and local values. Not a Go API break, but validation may fail on inputs that were accepted before.


## What's Changed (kpt API)

* Add generated ApplyConfiguration types by @mozesl-nokia in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4701
* Feature: Implement comprehensive field validation for Kptfile (#4735) by @adi-coderr in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4742
* [API] Add flag to explicitly preserve `null` values in merge by @mozesl-nokia in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4745
* Accept scp-style and local upstream.git.repo values in Kptfile validation by @chiliec in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4750
* Add a resource file name filter to kpt selectors and improve test/docs for selectors by @liamfallon in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4743
* [API] Move KubeObject to `api` module by @mozesl-nokia in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4767
* Fix json tag on ResourceFileRegexp by @efiacor in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4770

## New Contributors

* @adi-coderr made their first contribution in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4742
* @chiliec made their first contribution in https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/pull/4750

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/compare/api/v1.0.0...api/v1.1.0
